sources.excerpt: gn Policy MODULE - 6 India and the World 26 INDIA’S FOREIGN POLICY Notes Every sovereign country has its foreign policy. India too has one. Foreign policy refers to the sum total of principles, interests and objectives which a country promotes while interacting with other countries. Even though there are certain basic features of a foreign policy it is not a fixed concept. The thrust of foreign policy keeps on changing according to changing international conditions.
